title: Claude for Teaching & Research
text:
Faculty Workshop  ·  August 2026
    Claude for Teaching & Research
    
      Eight 1-hour sessions•
      Zoom•
      3:00 – 4:00 PM
    
    led by Kerry Back
    
    Week 1August 10–14
    AUG 10Intro to ClaudeClaude Desktop (Chat, Cowork, Code), Claude plugin for Excel
    AUG 11Claude Toolscode execution, command line, web search and fetch, and browser use
    AUG 12Skills, Connectors, and Pluginscustomizing Claude and adding capabilities
    AUG 13Research and Teaching SetupAcademic Studio, Python, R, LaTeX, Quarto, Git, GitHub
    AUG 14AI for TeachingNotebookLM, RAG chatbots, slide voice-overs
    Week 2August 17–19
    AUG 17Student Projectsartifacts, apps, agents
    AUG 18AI for Researchliterature search, knowledge databases, writing, and reviews
    AUG 19Agent Assistantsresearch team, personal assistants
